run_pipeline_generate_image: run the HiDreamImagePipeline to generate images from text prompts with guidance scale and inference steps
encode_prompt_multimodal: encode text prompts using four text encoders (CLIP, CLIP, T5, Llama3) with classifier-free guidance support
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random latent tensors with dimensions divisible by the VAE scale factor for image generation
check_pipeline_inputs: validate prompt, negative prompt, and pre-computed embedding inputs for the HiDreamImagePipeline
calculate_scheduler_shift: calculate the shift parameter for flow-matching schedulers based on image sequence length
